title: Framework Core Abstraction
description: Extract render-independent shared primitives and runtime shell into @framework/core; platform and playground product cores specialize it; fix framework/product workspace wiring.
summary: Fixed CAD/puzzle play window bodies showing "Unsupported UiNode": playground UiRenderer now routes cad, puzzle2d/3d/5d, and panel nodes through platform renderComponentHostSurface (registerSurfaceBinding). Legacy board/scene3d/table maps sync bindings to the platform registry. Exported renderComponentHostSurface from @framework/platform/renderer/react. Added vitest coverage (11 tests pass). Verified spatial play on fresh dev server (4 canvases, no unsupported nodes).
